'''Veir''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Major/Legends|major]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[Mos Ila]], he asked a fellow Imperial to deal with the local [[Exchange]] operation.<ref name="TOR" />
